dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About "In the Light, Beneath the Shadow"...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: This one's just a book of guessing games. The shrine maidens say that it's suitable for children of nine to twelve years, but I feel like it's more suitable for kids below eight.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: The borrower was just an ordinary citizen, so I suspect that you'll need a bit of luck finding this one.
